messages:
mike.cho: Ran into a weird failure with the Go SDK streaming path.

We have a long-running streaming call that uses automatic token refresh. When the token refresh happens mid-stream, the server returns 401 then the client retries, and we start seeing 429s for a bit.

mike.cho: stack snippet from the client logs:
```
stream: send chunk -> 401
retrying...
stream: retry -> 429 (no Retry-After)
backoff 200ms -> 400ms -> 800ms
```

sara.k: can you confirm if the retry is happening inside the SDK or in your app logic?

mike.cho: it's SDK-level. Go client has sync token refresh + automatic retry enabled.

alex.p: short answer: for non-idempotent streams you should avoid blind automatic retries. If the server supports resume tokens, prefer resume+checkpointing.

josh: for 429 handling specifically: honor `Retry-After` if present; if absent, use exponential backoff with capped jitter. Example we use in other clients:
```
func backoff(attempt int) time.Duration {
  base := 200 * time.Millisecond
  max := 10 * time.Second
  jitter := time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(base)))
  d := base << attempt
  if d > max { d = max }
  return d + jitter
}
```

vivian: also add a short suppress window after a stream reconnection. If token refresh caused a 401 then a retry floods, throttle app-level retries for ~1s.

sara.k: is there an open PR to change Go SDK behavior? If not I can submit one. We should make streaming retries opt-in and provide a resume callback.

mike.cho: I started a draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/78 — it toggles auto-retry for `OpenStream` and adds `OnResume(token string)` hook.

ci-bot: CI failed on go1.20 test `TestStreamResume` — flake due to race in mock server.

alex.p: ping @sara.k @josh can one of you review the PR? Key things: disable auto retry by default, expose resume token in response, and make Retry-After honored for 429.

sara.k: can do review tomorrow AM. Quick checklist for PR:
• add unit tests for Retry-After parsing
• ensure jitter math doesn't overflow
• document default behavior in README

mike.cho: thanks — I'll push fix for the mock server race and add test for header parsing.

josh: note for platform: servers should include Retry-After on throttles when coming from refresh storms. I'll file a tiny ops ticket.

mike.cho: created ticket OPS-452: add Retry-After header on auth storm throttles.

vivian: TL;DR: for Go SDK streams -> disable automatic retry by default, use resume tokens, honor Retry-After, try capping retries and add jitter. :thumbsup:

mike.cho: great, thanks everyone. I'll update the PR and ping reviewers when green.
